title: Internal citation audit
description: One row: counts and join checks for all references flagged as internal to the Columbia works snapshot.
code: SELECT (SELECT count(*)-count(DISTINCT topic_id) FROM topics) duplicate_topics, (SELECT count(*)-count(DISTINCT work_id) FROM works) duplicate_works, count(*) AS internal_rows, count(DISTINCT (c.citing_work_id,c.cited_work_id)) AS distinct_pairs, count(*) FILTER (WHERE a.work_id IS NULL OR b.work_id IS NULL) AS missing_works, count(*) FILTER (WHERE ta.field_id IS NULL OR tb.field_id IS NULL) AS unknown_pairs, count(*) FILTER (WHERE ta.field_id=tb.field_id) AS same_field, count(*) FILTER (WHERE ta.field_id<>tb.field_id) AS cross_field, count(*) FILTER (WHERE c.citing_work_id=c.cited_work_id) AS self_loops, count(DISTINCT ta.field_id) AS citing_fields, count(DISTINCT tb.field_id) AS cited_fields FROM citations c LEFT JOIN works a ON c.citing_work_id=a.work_id LEFT JOIN works b ON c.cited_work_id=b.work_id LEFT JOIN topics ta ON ta.topic_id=a.primary_topic_id LEFT JOIN topics tb ON tb.topic_id=b.primary_topic_id WHERE c.cited_in_snapshot
